parsed.summary: The PR addresses a confusing behavior in the partitions() function by copying the output dictionaries. It removes the note about reusing dictionaries and updates the docstring accordingly.

issues.description: The PR does not address the potential performance loss mentioned in the issue. The change could introduce a significant performance regression if copying dictionaries becomes a bottleneck.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the change does not introduce any new bugs or regressions.
